items.q: The flap that closes the foramen ovale after birth is formed by which structure?
items.exp: Septum primum forms the flap of the foramen ovale; rising left-atrial pressure after birth presses it against septum secundum.

items.q: A patent ductus arteriosus (PDA) is persistence of the link between which two vessels?
items.exp: The ductus arteriosus links the pulmonary artery to the aorta before birth; failure to close leaves a PDA with a left-to-right shunt.
